name: GreenDay
subtitle: Plan today. Keep the details.
promotionalText: Choose what to work on today, keep deadlines separate, and put notes, checklists, images, and equations beside each task.
description:
Plan the work. Keep the details close.

GreenDay brings tasks, calendars, and rich notes together in a focused workspace.

WORK DAYS AND DEADLINES
Choose one or several days to work on a task, even when those days are weeks apart. Keep its final deadline separate. Use Today to focus on the work you selected, or review approaching deadlines and priorities before planning your day.

NOTES THAT FIT THE WORK
Write Markdown, checklists, tables, and links alongside each task. Render inline and display LaTeX equations, then move into an equation to edit its source. Paste images into notes or keep documents beside the instructions they support.

YOUR NEXT SMALL STEP
Open checkboxes gathers unfinished checklist items from active tasks. Completing the parent task removes those items from this view without changing the note. Organize tasks with lists, tags, priorities, and a board.

CALENDARS ALONGSIDE TASKS
Connect calendars already configured in Apple Calendar, including iCloud and Google accounts. Switch between Month, Week, and Day. Link events to tasks and open the association from either side. Calendar access is optional.

YOUR WORKSPACE, YOUR DEVICES
Core task and note editing works offline and saves automatically. Select the same workspace folder in iCloud Drive on your Mac and iPhone to keep your files together. iCloud Drive handles transfers, so changes may take time to reach another device.

Optional Vim mode supports keyboard navigation and editing, including equation source. On iPhone, a hardware keyboard is useful for these shortcuts.

No GreenDay account is required. The app contains no advertising or analytics SDK.

testFlight.betaDescription: A focused planner with separate work days and deadlines, Markdown and LaTeX notes, checklists, images, and task-linked calendars. No GreenDay sign-in is required. Core editing works offline. To test sync, select the same folder in your own iCloud Drive on both devices.
testFlight.whatToTest: Use fictional tasks and a dedicated test calendar. Test nonconsecutive work days without changing the deadline; completion and Open checkboxes; cursor movement, selections, Vim mode, and Shift+J around equations and lists; pasted images and dropped documents; PDF/image opening; saving through backgrounding and relaunch; and offline edits on two devices using the same iCloud Drive workspace. Check calendar permission refusal, event edits, recurring occurrences, and links from both directions. A local save and provider delivery should be checked separately. On Mac, test the sandboxed release, folder reauthorization, and the transition from floating details to three columns.

distributionPlan.appRecord: One app record with matching release bundle identifiers for both platforms; reserve after checking the publisher account.
